title: Cross‑Boundary Experiment Stewardship & Rehearsal Notebook (WIP)
content:
Purpose
This is a working notebook for practicing cross-functional rollout choreography and creating a lightweight canonical rehearsal script + near-miss logging format. Intent: reduce surprises during live canaries and A/B runs by rehearsing the human coordination, guardrail checks, and incident handoffs ahead of time.

Audience
- Experiment owners (product, ML)
- Steward oncall (ops/solutions)
- Observability and SRE oncall
- Security/compliance rep (when experiment touches restricted data)

Scope / When to use this notebook
- Feature launches that change inference routing, model variant selection, or latency/cost tradeoffs for a significant cohort (>1% traffic)
- Multi-tenant rollouts with independent billing/SLAs
- Any A/B or canary that touches private-deployments or dedicated pools

Quick summary of the rehearsal concept
- Do a dry-run 48 hours before a live canary window.
- Rehearsal is a scripted, timeboxed simulation with live telemetry (shadow traffic, synthetic traffic) and explicit human handoffs.
- Rehearsal outputs a short 'readiness token' (pass/warn/fail) and a near-miss log if anything unexpected happened.

Roles & responsibilities (short)
- Steward (primary): runs the rehearsal script, tracks timeboxes, executes reversion steps.
- Observability lead: ensures dashboards loaded and signal extraction queries available.
- Owner (product/ML): validates quality metrics and approves the hypothesis.
- SRE: verifies capacity and latency SLOs.
- Compliance: verifies data path and KMS/keys for private artifacts (if applicable).

Rehearsal runbook (scripted timeline)
- Tminus 2d: pre-checks (all linked artifacts exist, tickets created, release notes written). Owner confirms.
- Tminus 24h: smoke dashboards shared with participants + rehearsal invite. Steward triggers synthetic traffic generator job (id: sim-rehearsal-<date>).
- Tminus 3h: quick capacity probe: 10k requests per minute to staging replica for 15 minutes. SRE reports any throttles or dropped requests.
- Tminus 1h: rehearsed handoff walkthrough (15m) — run through the decision matrix and fallback mapping.
- Rehearsal window (45m):
  - Step 1 (0-10m): Activate shadow routing of 1% production traffic to the variant (no user-facing switch). Validate telemetry ingestion.
  - Step 2 (10-25m): Inject small synthetic samples that exercise edge-case prompts and monitoring triggers. Verify rerankers, embeddings, and downstream checks.
  - Step 3 (25-40m): Owner reviews quality sample set and approves moving to canary (hypothetical). Steward practices cutover and rollback steps, including updating routing policy and activating fallback.
  - Debrief (40-45m): Fill out readiness token + near-miss log.

Minimal instrumentation checklist (before rehearsal)
- Dashboards: latency by route, p95/p99 token service time, error rate by status code, model regressions by eval-set, cost delta estimate.
- Alerts: latency p99 > target * 1.5; error rate > baseline + 0.5%; skew in distribution of model variants > 2x expected slice.
- Trace collections: sampling keys for steward to request traces for specific requests.
- Synthetic tests: can produce deterministic examples for owner to judge quality.

Near-miss logging template (one-line per event; keep short)
- timestamp | component | symptom | impact | mitigation attempted | next action owner
Examples:
- 2025-02-14T14:10Z | routing-proxy | 502 spike on /v1/chat | 0.2% of requests failed | scaled proxy pool, flushed routing cache | SRE follow-up: ENG-4937
- 2025-02-14T14:22Z | model-variant | tokenization OOM on long prompt | synthetic sample failed | trimmed inputs, switched to shorter context path | Owner: add long-context test to eval suite

Decision gate matrix (rehearsal pass -> live canary)
- Metrics to be green for pass: p99 latency within 1.2x of baseline, error rate delta < 0.3%, quality regression on key eval set < 1% (owner judgement), no security/compliance flags.
- If any metric in red -> follow "warn" flow: pause, expand sample, or rollback to baseline.
- Explicit signoff required: Steward + Observability lead + Owner.

Rollback & escape hatch quick commands (examples)
- Soft fallback: update router to route traffic back to baseline variant (api call)
  - curl -X POST https://router.redwood/api/v1/route/update -d '{"route":"chat:default","variant":"baseline"}'
- Hard cutoff: set traffic weight to 0 for experiment id
  - rctl experiments set-weight --id exp-20250214-7 --weight 0
- Emergency: disable model-serving pool (only SRE)

Readiness token (format to record at the end of rehearsal)
- pass | warn (with reason) | fail (with reason)
- quick notes (3 bullets max) and jira ticket if follow-ups required

Practice checklist items (practice-only; steward ticks)
- [ ] Confirm participants responded to invite
- [ ] Synthetic generator job id created and running
- [ ] Observability queries loaded into a shared dashboard tab
- [ ] Rehearsal dry-run: steward ran step 1 & 2 locally
- [ ] Near-miss template ready in sheet and accessible

Common rehearsal failure modes (field notes)
- Silent telemetry: event ingestion lag means we saw nothing — solved by enabling debug-level sampling and local trace capture.
- Overconfident owner approval: owner says "looks ok" on 10 samples but misses rare failure mode — mitigate by required a second-judge sampling (SRE or Observability).
- Rehearsal drift: synthetic traffic doesn't match production distribution; sometimes causes false sense of safety. Keep a small holdout of production randomized samples where permitted.

Post-rehearsal debrief template (complete within 24h)
- What happened (3 bullet timeline)
- Near-misses recorded (attach template)
- Decision: go/no-go (and why)
- Actions & owners (Jira created)
- Lessons (one-sentence)

Open questions / TODOs (short list)
- Do we want a short automated runner that orchestrates the rehearsal timeline? (low-effort automation could call synthetic generator + dashboards + mark checklist)
- How to incorporate privacy team earlier for private deployments? propose a 48h advance ticket for compliance review.
- Template for second-judge independent quality check — make it a required checkbox for >5% traffic cohort.

Notes to self / scribbles
- Consider adding a small canary simulation harness in the repo so experiments can be mode-switched to rehearsal mode (replay mode).
- Add a "rehearsal flag" in our experiment metadata so dashboards can filter rehearsal runs from live runs.

Links (working)
- rollout guardrails draft: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/EX/rollout-guardrails-v2
- synthetic generator doc: internal doc link (TODO add)

If you want to run a rehearsal this week ping me (Maya) and @SRE on slack and I will schedule the 45m window.

-- end notebook --
